facts.text: The Westbury is a luxury five-star hotel in central Dublin.
facts.excerpt: The Westbury, a member of Leading Hotels of the World, is a luxury 5 star hotel in central Dublin.

facts.text: The hotel's address is Balfe Street, Dublin 2.
The Westbury is owned and managed by The Doyle Collection, an Irish family-owned luxury hotel group with hotels in Dublin, London, Washington DC and Cork.
